name: noodleplanner
description: Front-end tooling for NoodlePlanner. The app has no bundler: the libraries the browser loads (mppwriter, jspdf, docx, DejaVu Sans Mono, exceljs, jszip, pptxgenjs) are vendored into static/vendor/<lib> by the `npm run vendor:<lib>` scripts.

scripts.vendor: npm run vendor:mppwriter && npm run vendor:jspdf && npm run vendor:docx && npm run vendor:dejavu && npm run vendor:exceljs && npm run vendor:jszip && npm run vendor:pptxgenjs
scripts.test:js: node --test tests/test_mpp_browser_export.mjs tests/test_mpp_assignment_warning.mjs tests/test_pdf_docx_browser_export.mjs tests/test_pptx_browser_export.mjs tests/test_engine_date_math.mjs tests/test_engine_tokeniser.mjs tests/test_engine_conformance.mjs tests/test_markdown_roundtrip.mjs tests/test_browser_excel_export.mjs tests/test_raid_sync.mjs tests/test_msproject_sync.mjs tests/test_msproject_task_diff.mjs tests/test_raid_comms_section_collision.mjs && for f in tests/test_*.js; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
